main_text.head: IN CONSTITVTIONIBVS ECCLESIÆ SCOTICANÆ, quæ PSALTERIO Metrico præmittuntur, Cap. de Sepultura.

p.i: Funus reverenter efferendum est, & ad Sepulchrum comitante Congregatione deducendam, absque ulterioribus cæremoniis. Et sepulto cadavere, Minister si præsens sit, & rogetur, proficiscatur ad Ecclesiam, si non procul distet, & habeat aliquam consolotariam exhortationem ad populum, de morte & resurrectione.

main_text.head: CAPUT XV. De Baptismo in privatis locis. Item, de Infantibus Apostatarum & Excommunicatorum.
main_text.p: IOANNES CALVINUS, in Epistola quæ incipit, Rogatus sententiam, Lib. Epistolarum, Col. 441.

I.AS non est administrare Baptismum, nisi in cœtu fidelium. Non quidem, ut Templum requiratur, sed ut ubivis numerus aliquis fidelium conveniat, qui Ecclesiæ corpus efficiat, & qui baptizat pro Pastore agnoscatur.

page.notes: The initial "E" of paragraph I is a woodcut initial and is read here as the likely letter; the first word is therefore reconstructed as "AS" with the initial "E" joined before it ("EAS" in the scan reads as "NAS"/"EAS" – uncertain). The first heading's wording is partly in small capitals and has been reproduced as printed.
